_comment: mock plugin — the reference run. Its identity and login are synthetic seed
data, so they are committed here rather than kept in config.local.json.
Two conformance plans run back to back here, each with its own client/jwks
file (both gitignored — see conformance-suite-private/). The fapi2 entry pins
profile=full, which is also the default, so narrowing run.profile to smoke
cannot send it looking for a curated list that does not ship. api and
e2e still run once, and everything lands in one report. To run only one of
them: ./run-all.sh -c data/config/config.mock.json --check to see the order, then drop the
entry you do not want (or point both at the same config_file if the same
clients are registered for both profiles).
api.flow_client_id is a client id registered on YOUR deployment, so it is left
empty here — the authorize-negative scenarios report ENV_NOT_READY until you
set it in config.local.json or via FLOW_CLIENT_ID.
Also required from config.local.json or the environment, because this file
selects all three surfaces: esignet.base_url (api + e2e) and
client before it runs). Without them the run stops at config validation.

//known_issues: Release baseline for 2.0.x. Every conformance module listed here is an
already-triaged gap, reproduced identically on mock, mosipid and sunbird,
so it is reported in the Known bucket with its reason instead of being run
and re-triaged every release. known_issues sits on run.* so it covers both
plans; a name a plan never selects is a silent no-op.
Taken from the 2026-09-10/16 full runs (t-220/219/212, f-38, sk-4):
29 FAILED + 8 HARNESS ERROR + 1 WARNING + 4 suite-side SKIPPED = 42
modules. 25 of the 29 are the one client-assertion failure at the token
endpoint, so fixing that alone retires most of this list.
RELEASE BRANCHES ONLY. Do not carry this to develop-go, where these
modules must keep running so a fix or a regression stays visible.

core: discovery does not list RS256 in id_token_signing_alg_values_supported, which OIDCD-3 requires (OIDCCCheckDiscEndpointIdTokenSigningAlgValuesSupported)

core: request_parameter_supported is absent from discovery so it defaults to false (CheckDiscEndpointRequestParameterSupported); the flow then also loses state (CheckStateInAuthorizationResponse) and hits the same 401 invalid_client at the token endpoint
core: the authorization endpoint does not return an access_denied error when the user cancels or denies consent, so the suite sees no error response (RFC6749-4.1.2.1, OIDCC-3.1.2.6)
core: the userinfo response carries a non-JSON content-type and a body that is not a JSON object, which this module requires (EnsureContentTypeJson, OIDCC-5.3.2)
core: replaying an authorization code does not make the resource endpoint answer with the expected 4xx (EnsureHttpStatusCodeIs4xx, RFC6749-4.1.2, RFC6750-3.1); the suite records this one as a warning
harness: the module waits on a server key rotation it never observes and times out after 120s while still in CONFIGURED, so no conformance verdict is produced

harness: the module drives a redirect_uri the conformance client does not have registered, so authorize returns eSignet's error page invalid_request (Invalid redirect URI) and the harness cannot hand a result back to the suite
